concerns.text: Contradiction with Constitution: T002a specifies 'DAE reconstruction loss', but Constitution Principle VI explicitly mandates 'knowledge-distillation loss'. An implementer cannot deterministically choose the correct objective.
Missing inherited requirement: T002a fails to include the perplexity-based skip logic ('if perplexity exceeds a threshold of 50, the dream phase must be skipped') required by spec.md (Edge Cases).
Missing inherited requirement: T005 fails to implement the 'insufficient power' flagging for evaluation sets with n < 5 samples per seed, as required by spec.md (Edge Cases).
